nolviko.importer.acknowledge: The source is frozen and I accept restricted visibility until review.
nolviko.importer.activate_members: Let imported members sign in (members who must reset their password stay suspended)
nolviko.importer.attachment_root: Attachment folder on this server (full path; empty if the forum has no attachments)
nolviko.importer.before_links: Old topic and post addresses redirect to the new ones when Nolviko runs at the old forum's address.
nolviko.importer.before_passwords: Members keep their old password where its format can be carried over; the others must use "Forgot password" and are listed in the notes.
nolviko.importer.before_permissions: Permissions of the old forum are not copied: imported forums stay hidden until you publish the import, then follow their parent forum and the site default.
nolviko.importer.collision: An account conflicts with an existing account. Resolve the source identity before retrying.
nolviko.importer.completed: Import verified. Review accounts and permissions before opening access.
nolviko.importer.confirm_publish: I have reviewed the import and want to open it
nolviko.importer.db_prefix: Table prefix (leave empty to find it)
nolviko.importer.denied: Sign in again as an administrator and submit securely.
nolviko.importer.excluded: Not copied; review the migration report
nolviko.importer.import_changed: Verification found changed or missing records. Keep the source frozen and review the import.
nolviko.importer.import_confirm_required: Confirm the frozen source and restricted initial visibility.
nolviko.importer.import_failed: The batch stopped safely. Saved batches remain available; check the source configuration.
nolviko.importer.import_files_needed: The original attachment files are missing or cannot be read. Check the source's attachment folder.
nolviko.importer.import_not_complete: The import is not finished yet.
nolviko.importer.import_policy: Import from a copy of your old forum (or with the old forum closed). Imported forums stay hidden and imported members cannot sign in until you publish the import. Private messages become personal archives. Files remain download-only.
nolviko.importer.import_reload: Reload the saved progress before continuing.
nolviko.importer.import_setup: Add the database of your old forum below to start.
nolviko.importer.note_aggregate: Unattributed or duplicate ballot remains in the original aggregate total.
nolviko.importer.note_identity: System or deleted identity; no new access was granted.
nolviko.importer.note_linked: Explicitly linked to the importing owner; credentials and privileges preserved.
nolviko.importer.note_orphan: Owned orphan file retained in a private archive.
nolviko.importer.note_password: Account remains suspended; a password reset is required.
nolviko.importer.note_unowned: Unowned file was not published; retain it in the source backup.
nolviko.importer.notes_total: {count, plural, one {# note in total.} other {# notes in total.}} Page {page} of {pages}.
nolviko.importer.publish_intro: Imported forums are hidden and imported members cannot sign in yet. When you have reviewed the result, open them here.
nolviko.importer.run_auto: The import runs by itself while this page is open. If you close it, it continues from the saved point when you come back.
nolviko.importer.run_paused: The import paused. Press "Continue the import" to carry on from the saved point.
nolviko.importer.source_added: The source was checked and saved.
nolviko.importer.source_ambiguous: More than one forum was found in this database. Enter the table prefix of the one to import.
nolviko.importer.source_attachments_miss: The attachment folder was not found or cannot be read.
nolviko.importer.source_attachments_requ: This forum has attachments: enter the folder that holds the original files.
nolviko.importer.source_charset_differs: The source tables use another character set than the one chosen; the detected one is used.
nolviko.importer.source_fields_invalid: Check the fields: forum software, server, port, database name, user name, table prefix and folder.
nolviko.importer.source_intro: Enter the database of your old SMF, MyBB or phpBB forum. Nolviko finds the forum, its version and its table prefix and shows what it holds before anything is copied. The password is stored encrypted and never shown again.
nolviko.importer.source_not_found: No SMF, MyBB or phpBB tables were found in this database. Check the database name and table prefix.
nolviko.importer.source_removed: The source was removed. Imports made from it are kept.
nolviko.importer.source_unavailable: Could not connect to the source database. Check the server, user name, password and database name.
nolviko.importer.source_version_unsuppor: This version is not supported yet. Supported: SMF 2.1, MyBB 1.8 and phpBB 3.3.
nolviko.importer.source_writable: Advice: this database account can change the source. Use a copy of the forum or a read-only account.
